text:
Situation: Midazolam hydrochloride has been on FDA's drug shortage list since 2020-04-02 and remains current as of 2026-10-21. Hospira, Inc. and Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. are listed among affected manufacturers. Current inventory across Corvale sites ranges from 9.9 to 28.8 days of supply.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2020-04-02. Hospira's plant (FEI 1925262) received an OAI classification after an inspection ending 2018-08-15, 596 days before the shortage posting. Pfizer Healthcare India Private Limited (FEI 3008316085) received an OAI classification after an inspection ending 2019-09-06, 209 days before the shortage posting. A Warning Letter was issued to Pfizer Healthcare India Private Limited on 2020-03-25, 8 days before the shortage posting. Hospira's plant (FEI 1925262) received another OAI classification letter dated 2020-04-22, 20 days after the shortage posting.

Our position: Supply is constrained but not exhausted. The rule-based best option is to purchase from A-S Medication Solutions, which is not on FDA's shortage list today. Four additional suppliers also are not on the shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with A-S Medication Solutions as primary source; buyer approves.
2. Buyer to qualify B. Braun Medical Inc., Belcher Pharmaceuticals LLC, Cardinal Health 107 LLC, and Civica Inc. as backup sources; buyer approves.
3. Buyer to monitor daily inventory and FDA shortage updates; buyer approves.
4. Pharmacy director to review allocation if any site falls below 7 days; pharmacy director approves.

Not recommended: Switching to alternative agents or changing clinical protocols; those decisions belong to treating clinicians and the committee.
